tools.description: The Vogue Paris cover from a given date: a birthday, an anniversary, a month in history. A full date or a month returns the issue on or nearest that date (within two months). tools.description: Vogue Paris covers from one decade: the 1920s (flappers, Art Deco), the 1930s, the 1940s (wartime and the New Look) or the early 1950s. tools.name: vogue_by_season
tools.description: Vogue Paris issues from one season of one year (spring = March-May, summer = June-August, autumn = September-November, winter = December and the January-February after it), with covers as images for 1930 and earlier. tools.name: translate_vogue_page
tools.description: Returns pages of a Vogue Paris issue as images in the original French, up to 4 at a time, for reading and translation into English or any language. Where the site has already transcribed a page, its French text and an English translation come back with it (marked machine-made). Page 1 is the cover.

tools.name: random_vintage_vogue_cover
tools.description: One Vogue Paris cover picked at random from the public-domain years (1920-1930), or from a narrower span of years, returned as an image with its date and reader link. Example questions: "a random vintage Vogue cover"; "surprise me with a 1920s fashion cover"; "a Vogue cover of the day".

tools.name: can_i_use_vogue_images
tools.description: US copyright status of a Vogue Paris issue or year: whether it is in the US public domain, the statute behind it, and the year a later issue enters it.
